toolsPreview.name: get_nursing_care_plan
toolsPreview.description: Get a nursing care plan for a specific condition: priority NANDA-style nursing diagnoses with evidence, SMART goals, key interventions each with a rationale, and clinical sources (MedlinePlus, NCBI, NIH). Written for nursing students preparing care plans. Use when a nursing student asks for a care plan, nursing diagnoses, interventions or goals for any condition (e.g. sepsis, CHF, COPD, diabetes, pneumonia). Educational reference, not medical advice.
